dedupe_keys.name: navires de transport de marchandises a la ctn

description: Navires de transport de marchandises à la CTN is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Compagnie Tunisienne de Navigation CTN. ce jeu de données décrit la liste des navires du transport des marchandises à la propriété de la compagnie tunisienne de navigation et en location ainsi que leurs caractéristiques techniques et leur destination des voyages. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Compagnie Tunisienne de Navigation CTN. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
